title: Jeff GET /v1/functions response
description: Every function of every adapter the server's engine has loaded, with what a caller needs to call it (the same fields as the adapter's manifest), and the weight format of the base it serves.

base_format.description: The weight format of the base the server's engines serve (as their health's base.format and base.format_id): {"format": "bf16"}, or for an INT4 base {"format": "int4-g64", "format_id": <that INT4 base's name>}. On an INT4 base a function decides with its calibration_by_format entry for format_id, not with calibration.

id.description: The function's own ID: the adapter's ID, a dot, the function's key.

aliases.description: The other references that name this function: each of its adapter's aliases (in its manifest's order), a dot and the function's key, for example jeff.routing.router-open.specialist for jeff.routing.router-open-v14.specialist, or spam.is_spam for jeff.safety.spam.is_spam. A decision made through one of them still reports id. This server always sends it; it is not required, so a client still reads the answer of a server from before the field (read a missing one as an empty list).

context.description: The function's context fields (its own when the manifest declares them for the function, else the adapter's), each with its code_name always given (declared or derived): callers pass context by code name; key is the field as the prompt shows it.

input.description: The function's input field (its own when the manifest declares it for the function, else the adapter's), with its code_name always given (declared or derived).
